faq.a: Badee is associated with the Arabic form بديع, whose core sense is new, fresh, marvellous.

faq.q: What is the origin of Badee?
faq.a: Badee is associated with Arabic. Badīʿ ('new, fresh, marvellous, unprecedented'); al-Badīʿ is one of the divine names.
Yes — the underlying form بديع is Arabic.
Badee can occur in Muslim naming contexts, but it is better described as a Arabic-origin name used within some Muslim naming traditions than as an exclusively Islamic religious term.
Badee should not be classified as a Quranic personal name without a direct Quranic basis. البديع is a name of God in the Qur'an (2:117)
